boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named destinations on Kirkwood Avenue, connecting the IU Bloomington edge with downtown.

cards.title: Sample Gates
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor at Indiana Avenue
cards.notes: Start at the limestone gateway, then use the plaza as the clear handoff between campus and the Kirkwood Avenue walk.
cards.short_summary: A documented IU gateway and campus-city landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: IU’s master plan identifies the Sample Gates at East Kirkwood and North Indiana Avenues as a pedestrian gateway and portal between campus and Bloomington.
cards.source_title: IU Bloomington 2020 Campus Master Plan Update
cards.access_notes: Outdoor gateway and plaza; observe posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Gables Bagels
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 200 E. Kirkwood Ave.
cards.notes: Stop for a bagel or sandwich at the Kirkwood counter, then continue west toward the library and downtown storefronts.
cards.short_summary: A named bagel shop directly on the avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Gables Bagels lists its Kirkwood location at 200 E. Kirkwood Ave. and offers bagels and sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are optional; check the business page for current ordering details.

cards.entity_name: Monroe County Public Library Downtown Library
cards.title: Downtown Library
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 303 E. Kirkwood Ave.
cards.notes: Use the Downtown Library’s public spaces for a quiet reset, or look for current programs before returning to Kirkwood.
cards.short_summary: A public library branch with meeting rooms, teen space, and a digital creativity center.
cards.evidence_claim: MCPL states that the Downtown Library is on Kirkwood Avenue and provides meeting rooms, children’s and teen spaces, and a digital creativity center.
cards.source_title: Monroe County Public Library — Downtown Library branch information
cards.access_notes: Public branch access is subject to library policies and current hours.

cards.title: Juniper Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 615 W. Kirkwood Ave.
cards.notes: Walk west to view the gallery’s current work, and check its posted schedule if you want to align with a Gallery Walk.
cards.short_summary: An arts-district gallery on the west end of Kirkwood.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniper Art Gallery lists its location at 615 W. Kirkwood Ave. in Bloomington’s Arts & Entertainment District and participates in First Friday Gallery Walks.
cards.source_title: Juniper Art Gallery — Contact and Hours
cards.access_notes: Check the gallery’s posted hours and exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Fountain Square Gallery Wall
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 101 W. Kirkwood Ave.
cards.notes: Enter Fountain Square from Kirkwood and pause at the atrium gallery wall, where changing exhibitions are coordinated locally.
cards.short_summary: A rotating gallery wall visible from Fountain Square’s Kirkwood entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Fountain Square says its Kirkwood entrance leads to the atrium, where the FS Gallery Wall displays exhibitions coordinated with the City of Bloomington.
cards.access_notes: Gallery-wall viewing is within Fountain Square; follow building access guidance.

cards.title: By Hand Gallery
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 101 W. Kirkwood Ave., #109
cards.notes: Browse the cooperative gallery’s handmade work, then continue through Fountain Square rather than treating the stop as a quick pass-by.
cards.short_summary: A locally owned cooperative gallery representing artisan members and additional artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Indiana’s tourism office identifies By Hand Gallery at 101 W. Kirkwood Avenue as a locally owned cooperative gallery with artisan members and additional artists.
cards.access_notes: Merchandise purchases are optional; check the gallery for current access details.

cards.title: Kirkwood Candle Bar
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 101 W. Kirkwood Ave., Suite 116
cards.notes: Browse the candle and gift selection inside the Kirkwood storefront, then keep the stop focused on the shop rather than a scheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: A named gift and candle storefront in Fountain Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Kirkwood Candle Bar lists its storefront at 101 W. Kirkwood Ave., Suite 116, and identifies candle and gift brands it carries.
cards.access_notes: Retail purchases are optional; consult the storefront for current hours.

cards.title: The Uptown Cafe
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 102 E. Kirkwood Ave.
cards.notes: Plan a breakfast, lunch, dinner, or brunch stop here if you want a seated meal along the downtown portion of Kirkwood.
cards.short_summary: A Kirkwood restaurant with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and brunch menus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Uptown Cafe lists its address as 102 East Kirkwood Avenue and states that it serves breakfast, lunch, dinner, and brunch.
cards.access_notes: A meal requires purchase; review current menus and reservation information before visiting.

cards.title: Kirkwood Sweet Shop
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 112 E. Kirkwood Ave.
cards.notes: Choose a pastry, chocolate, or coffee stop here, using the shop’s current bakery case rather than expecting a fixed menu.
cards.short_summary: A downtown sweets shop with pastries, chocolates, and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Kirkwood Sweet Shop lists 112 E. Kirkwood Ave. and describes coffee, pastries, handcrafted chocolates, and custom cakes.
cards.access_notes: Food and drink purchases are required; the bakery case and menu can change.

cards.title: Buskirk-Chumley Theater
cards.subtitle: Kirkwood Avenue corridor — 114 E. Kirkwood Ave.
cards.notes: Check the theater’s current schedule and choose a public performance or community event that fits your visit to the avenue.
cards.short_summary: A historic nonprofit community performance venue on Kirkwood.
cards.evidence_claim: The Buskirk-Chumley Theater identifies itself as a nonprofit that operates a historic community performance venue at 114 E. Kirkwood Ave.
cards.access_notes: Performance access and ticket requirements vary by event; check the theater’s schedule.
